description:
FILED s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 2).  PRE-EXISTING.  A HOLDING
task, deliberately: it exists so 24 rows carry a cause that says "measured,
and it is a scatter" instead of nothing.  Do NOT treat it as one bug.

t/comp/parser.t is the only `comp/` file with `op/`'s shape -- 134 distinct
description shapes over 140 fail rows.  Its rows split three ways (the split
was MEASURED by locating each description's source line,
`scratch/s473t5c/classify-parser.pl`):

  72  never produced  -> #1694 (five #138 drops in the `#line`-tracking
                        section plus the abort they leave)
  44  assert `$@`'s TEXT for invalid perl
                      -> not-supported.md §Error compatibility for invalid
                         Perl input + §Error message text
  24  THIS TASK

The 24, with what each actually asks:

  t1        `eval '%@x=0;'`                    -- a `%@` sigil pair
  t18/19/23/25  `"${a}{"` / `s/${a}\{/` / a heredoc terminator `<<"${a}{"`
                -- a braced interpolation immediately followed by a literal
                   `{`; four spellings of one question, the closest thing to
                   a family in this set
  t68/70    over-long identifiers in `$#` and `$` sigil context (the source
            line is generated, so the classifier could not locate it)
  t88/93/94/95/96  a sub declaration (stub / +attr / +proto / non-empty) must
            leave NO stash entry after the enclosing eval had a COMPILATION
            error -- five rows, one fact, and it needs the live-stash half
            (not-supported.md §Live symbol-table hashes) to be observable at all
  t98       `format` inside a `(?{ ... })` re-eval
  t100      pod inside a string, outside a string eval
  t102/103  heredocs inside a multiline quoted construct in a string eval;
            unterminated heredocs in `s///` in a string eval
  t105      a literal `->` after an array subscript inside interpolation
  t107      `no if $] >= 5.17.4 warnings => "deprecated"` must not crash
  t111      `__PACKAGE__` is read-only (`for(__PACKAGE__) { eval '$_=42' }`)
            -- the read-only-scalar class (not-supported.md §A LITERAL ... is
            writable, not read-only)
  t136      `eval chr 0x387` must not loop the parser
  and the residue named in the classifier output.

SO: at least four of the 24 are already-registered classes wearing a
parser.t description (read-only scalars, live stash), and the four `${a}{`
rows are the one real sub-family worth a task of its own if someone probes
them.  Whoever picks this up should re-classify rather than trust the list --
it was built from one run's descriptions, and #1694's drops moving will change
which rows are even produced.
subject: t/comp/parser.t's 24-row SCATTER: `"${a}{"` interpolation, stash effects after a compilation error, `__PACKAGE__` read-only, heredocs in string eval, `format` in a re-eval -- one row per distinct assertion, no shared fact
